_about: House types for Ride UK (towns plan stage 4), read by World/WorldRideStyle.cpp (SetHouseTypes) and used by World/WorldRideBuildings.cpp. A house is a cottage (detached, out of town) or one of a village row; in a town a detached house, a semi, one of a terrace (a row of three or more, from the map's outlines that share walls: WorldRideOutlines.cpp MarkRows) or a tenement (three floors or more). Each kind lists its periods: 'weight' how common, 'window' place (the region's own), sash, casement, mullion or modern; 'bay' the share with a bay window on the front (Tools/make_facade_kit.py bay_canted, bay_square), 'bay_two' of those how many run up two storeys, 'bay_square' how many are square rather than canted; 'hipped' the share of squarish ones the map gives no roof shape that are hipped (-1 or left out: the place's habit); 'hood' the share of doors under a hood; 'doors' the door styles it uses (panel6, victorian, ledged, modern). A row or a street takes one period and one bay choice together. A kind left out keeps the built-in figures (the same as these).
